description: What serving a Hugging Face model takes, before anything is rented: the GPU memory it needs and the machines it fits on right now, best value first, each with its hourly price and a rough speed. Free; rents and changes nothing. Call it first whenever the person wants a model running (to chat with, call from code, generate images, video or speech, or run evals against), tell them the price, then deploy_model with the option's node_id and gpu_count.

engine.description: Default vllm. omni = vLLM-Omni (image, video, speech, audio).

extra_args.description: The person's own engine options, to check them before renting.

hf_token.description: A Hugging Face token, for a gated or private model.

model.description: A Hugging Face model id or link, for example Qwen/Qwen3-8B; for llama.cpp, owner/repo:QUANT.

name: plan_deploy
title: Plan a model deploy (free)
